status: Exploratory one-activation protocol specified before marking and scoring old permutations
question: Can a source centered within the previous occupancy/rank layer change the next activation, moving-root rank population and original U?
protocol: For each final K>=1 retain the previous K-1 and rank probabilities, exponentially tilt configurations within that layer and add one uniformly chosen vacant site. Final K has unchanged Bin(N,p) weight. At K=0 the tangent is zero.
protocol_boundary: A one-step-before-readout injection at each K; not one fixed early injection for every later K, not the original equilibrium bulk fugacity, not an inferred causal identity between the two sources
input_scope: Four cyclic sizes use the same original100k permutations; N260/N340 each use original1M. No new random counters. Endpoint batch is original1000 union later9000, not contiguous10k.
uncertainty: Recompute previous-rank conditional source means and event kernels after each aligned original delete-one batch; reuse the matching retained-sample root; keep full covariance across all recorded response components and sizes in the same dependency group.
primary_readout: root-comoving rank1 probability response to this lagged source
normalization: same exact DeltaCos4 and N^(13/8) as original U; no additional factor N because source already uses bulk units; no free exponent or q2/Jordan source-extension assumption
sampling_boundary: Empirical conditional centering and aligned jackknife; new joint observations of old configurations are not independent replications. Fixed sample budget, no optional continuation by significance.
